lines.text: Jesus says not one temple stone will be left on another, and the disciples ask when and what the sign will be.
Jesus warns that many will come in His name, and that wars, earthquakes, famines, and pestilences will happen first.
Jesus says that after the earthquakes and signs from heaven, the disciples will be seized and brought before kings and governors.

wrong_details.wrong: after the earthquakes and signs from heaven, the disciples will be seized
wrong_details.true: before all this, they will seize you and persecute you

lines.text: Jesus says the disciples will be betrayed by soldiers and relatives, but by patient endurance they will gain their souls.

wrong_details.true: parents and brothers and relatives and friends

lines.text: When Jerusalem is surrounded by armies, those in Judea should flee to the mountains, and the people will be led captive into all the nations.
